name: Beef Tacos
steps: Mix the ground cumin, sweet paprika and dried oregano in a small bowl with 1 tsp salt and a good grind of black pepper.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook the brown onion for 3-4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Turn the heat up to high, add the beef mince and brown it well, breaking up any lumps with a wooden spoon. Tip off any excess fat.
Stir in the spice mix and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in 125 ml water and simmer for 3-5 minutes, stirring now and then, until the filling is thick but still saucy.
Meanwhile, warm the taco shells in a 160°C oven for 4-5 minutes until crisp.
Put the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, cheddar cheese and sour cream in bowls on the table.
Spoon the beef filling into the warm shells and let everyone build their own tacos.
